title: EQT Corporation Form 8-K — Annual Meeting Results and LTIP Amendment
summary: EQT Corporation filed an 8-K reporting results from its April 14, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, including election of ten directors, approval of say-on-pay for 2025 executive compensation, and approval of a Third Amendment to the 2020 Long-Term Incentive Plan (adding 34 million shares to the pool and extending the plan term from 2030 to 2036). The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure and contains no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Shareholders elected all ten director nominees to one-year terms expiring at the 2027 annual meeting.
Say-on-pay resolution passed with 485,915,092 votes for (84.4%) against 27,460,142.
Third Amendment to 2020 LTIP approved with 505,134,172 votes for (97.4%), adding 34,000,000 authorized shares and eliminating a residual share pool from the 2024 Equitrans Midstream acquisition.
The LTIP term was extended from 2030 to 2036.
Proxy advisor ISS had recommended a vote against the LTIP amendment due to dilution concerns.
No material business events, earnings guidance, or strategic announcements were included in this 8-K filing.
